name: rose-surrounded-chic-heiress
image_vibe: Confident black tailoring surrounded by abundant deep red roses in a bright luxury setting
image_purpose: Create a high-fashion luxury lifestyle portrait for lookbook and campaign use.

prompt.project_info: A high-angle luxury editorial portrait of an original adult woman seated in a cream bouclé armchair surrounded by oversized dark red rose bouquets.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult woman with dark brown-black shoulder-length waves, black narrow oval sunglasses, a composed confident expression, a fitted black cropped blazer, elegant black lace-trimmed top, high-waisted black leather mini skirt, sheer black tights, and black pointed-toe pumps. Keep the styling fashion-editorial and avoid copying any identifiable public figure.
prompt.composition_elements: High-angle framing, subject seated in a cream bouclé armchair with legs crossed and one hand against her cheek, seven to eight large rose bouquets forming a complete ring around the chair, bright terrace with white marble floor and floor-to-ceiling glass windows, with the roses filling most of the environment.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft sun-drenched natural light from above and through the windows, vibrant deep red roses contrasting with the black outfit and cream chair, polished high-fashion luxury lifestyle mood, selective shallow depth of field with the subject in sharp focus.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic editorial fashion photography, high-angle composition, realistic skin pores, blazer weave, leather sheen, bouclé texture, rose petals and kraft-paper wrapping, high detail, 8K-style clarity, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic high-angle luxury editorial portrait of an original adult woman seated in a cream bouclé armchair on a sun-drenched terrace. Style her with dark shoulder-length waves, black oval sunglasses, a composed confident expression, a fitted black cropped blazer, elegant black lace-trimmed top, high-waisted black leather mini skirt, sheer black tights, layered gold jewelry, and black pointed-toe pumps. Cross her legs and rest one hand against her cheek. Surround the chair with seven to eight enormous bouquets of dark red roses wrapped in kraft and brown paper with burgundy satin ribbons, forming a complete ring and filling the space. Use a white marble floor, floor-to-ceiling glass windows, soft natural light, realistic skin and material textures, rich red-to-black contrast, shallow depth of field, high-fashion lifestyle photography, 8K-style clarity, and no text or watermark. Use an original face and do not imitate an identifiable public figure.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, minor or teen-coded subject, identifiable public-figure likeness, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, plastic skin, oversmoothed skin, malformed flowers, duplicate bouquets, unreadable text, watermark

assets.name: source rose-surrounded fashion portrait
assets.usage: Use only as optional guidance for the rose abundance, black-and-cream palette, chair arrangement, and luxury editorial composition; do not copy identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve the original concept: adult fashion subject, cream chair, abundant dark red rose bouquets, black tailored outfit, bright marble-and-glass luxury setting, and high-angle editorial composition. Identity may vary.

changes: Replaced identifiable public-figure reference with an original adult subject.
Removed unsupported identity-lock language and retained the fashion, floral, and luxury-scene intent.
